summary: The shell has a virtual on-screen controller with buttons, sticks and a direction pad, and a gamepad model that apps read. There is no Metal-facing touch control API, and no touchpad control.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run in this batch); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: controls placed in unit-square coordinates over the touch surface; apps cannot create them
a stick control exists; a throttle does not
physical controller state reaches apps; virtual control state is not routed to the game
no control artwork or render path for an app
no absolute or delta touchpad control

gaps: No Metal-facing touch controls for apps.
Virtual controller output is not exposed to the game API.
